Judge one fact extracted for a SysML v2 model from an engineering document. The fact names elements by their full names; the document may refer to them by aliases declared elsewhere (those declarations are included).

Fact: action(label=personnel, tools, and temporary connections are accounted for)

Source sentences (the last one is where the fact was extracted):
S093: The Control Room Operator evaluates reported field conditions before authorizing a return to automated operation.

S096: Work is considered complete only after personnel, tools, and temporary connections are accounted for and the work area is left in a safe state.
